subject: Post-demo recap & request: BrightHealth stakeholder roster + procurement handoff
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha@brighthealth.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap & request: BrightHealth stakeholder roster + procurement handoff

Hi Samantha — thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- Recap: demo covered streaming inference, cost/latency tradeoffs, and Dedicated sizing options. You indicated latency targets of ~120ms P95 for patient-facing flows and interest in a Dedicated pool for predictable throughput.
- Asks (what would help us complete the commercial proposal):
  1) A short stakeholder roster (who owns final decision / economic buying, security, legal, procurement contacts). Ideally title + email + role (e.g., "Economic buyer: Elaine Park, CIO — elaine.park@brighthealth.ai").
  2) Procurement timeline and any mandatory paperwork (PO, vendor registration, SOC2 requirement).
  3) Any non-negotiable decision criteria beyond latency/cost (data residency, IP, SLA levels).

I've attached the post-demo deck and the recording link for your team to share (attachment: redwood-post-demo-deck.pdf, Drive link below). If it helps, we can do a 30-min handoff with procurement + security next week to scope contract/controls.

Proposed next step: Could you share the stakeholder roster and indicate the procurement contact by EOD Monday? If procurement prefers an intro via email, I'll draft a short handoff note.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0112

Attachments: redwood-post-demo-deck.pdf
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-demo-materials

Hi Marcus — great walkthrough yesterday, thanks. Attaching an org chart and a short internal note on roles. See answers below: 

- Economic buyer: Elaine Park, CIO — elaine.park@brighthealth.ai (will be the final approver for budget).
- Security lead: Tom O'Neill, Head of Security — t.oneill@brighthealth.ai (copied).
- Legal lead: Priya Menon, Sr. Counsel — priya.menon@brighthealth.ai (not on this thread; I'll loop her in if we progress).
- Procurement: procurement@brighthealth.ai (team inbox). Our procurement manager is Rajesh Shah (raje.shah@brighthealth.ai) — he handles SOWs and PO routing.

Decision criteria we expect to score: latency SLA, predictable unit cost, SOC2 Type II or equivalent controls, data residency in US regions, and support for private deployments (VPC). Target procurement window: internal approvals by mid-July; preferred vendor onboarding by end of July. 

Attaching: BrightHealth_org_chart.pdf and our vendor_onboarding_packet.pdf (procurement checklist).

Thanks,
Samantha Reed
Director of Data Products | BrightHealth Analytics
samantha@brighthealth.ai

1) SOC2: Redwood can provide our latest SOC2 Type II report and a security questionnaire. Jordan (copied) will follow up with the security packet and a short write-up on encryption/KMS options for your legal/security team.
2) Procurement handoff: we'll prepare a one-page commercial summary and a proposed SOW template for Rajesh to review. Ben will draft standard commercial terms and note any optional SLAs for Dedicated.

Could you do a short intro to Rajesh + Priya on this thread (or let me know if you prefer we send a formal intro)? If Rajesh prefers, we can schedule a 30-min procurement kick-off Wed or Thu this week (09:00-11:00 PT windows work for us).

Thanks — Marcus

Hi Samantha — Jordan here from the security & platform team at Redwood. Thanks for sharing the chart and the onboarding packet. Attaching our standard security packet and a short SOC2 summary for quick review. Highlights you might want to share with Priya and Tom: 

- SOC2 Type II report available; encryption in transit and at rest using customer-managed KMS is supported.
- Private deployment options: VPC peering and on-prem bundle (air-gapped) are both available for regulated workloads.
- We maintain audit logs per-route and can provide per-token usage tracing for compliance reviews.

Ben — per Marcus' note, can you prepare the one-page commercial summary (monthly Dedicated pricing + estimated token costs) and a redline-friendly SOW template? We'll include the SOC2 and security packet in the handoff call materials.

Happy to jump on the procurement handoff Wed 30 Jun at 10:00 AM PT if that works for Rajesh — Samantha, can you confirm Rajesh's availability or loop him in?

Best,
Jordan Blake
